claims.text: Artificial intelligence systems are being widely adopted in public health.
Adoption of artificial intelligence systems in public health affects evidence generation processes.
Adoption of artificial intelligence systems in public health affects decision-making processes.
Concerns regarding data interpretation and ethics of accountability in AI governance in healthcare conceivably mitigate risks related to health inequities in global healthcare systems.
The proposed strategy addresses AI literacy through a holistic approach across its multiple domains.

methodologies.description: A proposed strategy taking a holistic approach to address diverse domains of artificial intelligence literacy in public health governance and decision-making.
